claim: No generated refinement yet. Front/back depth is now calculated from one volume, not duplicated ribbon art.

observed.south: Anterior crown roots now sit above the original head; posterior loop recedes and original flesh ears remain separate.
observed.east: Upper/anterior root rises and sweeps backwards, then returns forward above the flesh ear.
observed.north: Anterior root disappears behind skull; rounded posterior tube is in front of the upper skull sides. Returning tip is partly concealed rather than copied as the full front spiral.
observed.limitation: Symmetric orthographic front/back outlines can resemble each other. Surface visibility and skull-relative depth, not an arbitrary silhouette flip, establish the physical turn.
